entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello? I'd like to make a return.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the item? What specifically is the issue?
It's the Urban Commuter Helmet I bought a while back. There's nothing wrong with it, the box is still unopened. The issue is really just the color. It wasn't what I expected.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important, especially for a helmet you'll be wearing every day for your safety. Let me just pull up your order information... one moment.
Okay, I see the order. It looks like the helmet was delivered 79 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Great news. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date, so you are well within the window. I can process a full refund for you right now.

That's good to hear. Now, since the box is unopened, it saves you all the trouble of inspecting and restocking a used item. Because of that, would you be able to add a small discount code to my account for my next purchase? I'm going to order the same helmet in a different color.

I appreciate you keeping the item in perfect condition, and I'm glad to hear you're sticking with VeloFit for your next helmet. While I can't add an additional discount code, I can assure you'll receive the full purchase price back once we receive the item. I am happy to get that return process started for you.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fine. Let's do that.

Excellent. I have just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Please attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed within 5-7 business days.
Perfect, that's easy enough. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
